messages:
emily-partners: Heads upGCP Marketplace + NVIDIA partner asked for a compact onboarding pack: refarch diagram, Terraform modules for private/dedicated (GKE with node pools or bare metal DGX), and a tiny sample app that writes to a locked model bucket. Need this for partner enablement call next Fri. Who can own modules + packaging?
jerome-eng: I can own the Terraform modules for GCP. Plan: module for network (VPC + private service connect), module for GKE/dedicated GPU pool, module for model-artifact bucket + IAM. Will add notes for TPU vs DGX differences.
anika-arch: I'll do the refarch and include separate flow for marketplace listing (how billing/procurement maps to our private control plane). Also include KMS envelope encryption example.
tom-docs: I'll take the marketplace packaging guide + short partner-facing quickstart. Need a minimal terraform snippet to show in docs. Can someone paste one? :eyes:
cory-field: quick snippet we used in labs, redacted:
```hcl
module "redwood_gcp_dedicated" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules//gcp/dedicated"
  project = "partners-sample"
  region = "us-central1"
  gpu_type = "nvidia-a100"
  gpu_count = 2
  vpc = module.vpc.network
}
```
jerome-eng: thanks. I'll add that to examples and include a GKE node pool snippet with node taints/labels to isolate inference workloads. Also will document required service accounts and IAM roles.
anika-arch: partner asked about private telemetry only (no PII). We'll include an architecture note: audit logs -> customer-owned Logging sink -> BigQuery with masking transform. I'll sketch the diagram.
tom-docs: packaging checklist draft: images/screenshots, licensing entitlements, contact info, support SLA, thumbnail + short blurb, install commands, terraform example, troubleshooting section. I'll drop a PR.
ops-bot: CI: preview site created for partners/gcp-nvidia/PR-7 -> https://preview.redwood.dev/partners/gcp-nvidia/PR-7 (expires in 72h)
emily-partners: timeline? partner wants drafts by Wed EOD for internal review. Is that doable?
jerome-eng: Wed EOD for initial modules + examples is tight but doable if I get AMI/container details. Need confirmation on supported CUDA drivers and whether we provide prebuilt container images for DGX.
cory-field: I'll confirm with NVIDIA partner ops and share a driver compatibility matrix.
anika-arch: also tagging security: we need to include S3-equivalent bucket locking (GCS retention) and sample KMS policy for cross-project keys.
tom-docs: PR template will force checklist items. Will include a 'marketplace acceptance' bullet list.
emily-partners: blockers?
jerome-eng: blocker: no Packer pipeline for DGX base images in infra. We can recommend partner-provided images as fallback.
anika-arch: blocker: need legal on licensing blurb for marketplace page. I'll loop in legal.
cory-field: sent note to nvidia-ops. they should confirm driver list by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Reminder: partnerships weekly sync in 1 day.
emily-partners: OK great. Actions: 1) jerome create repo + module skeleton (today) 2) anika drop refarch draft (tomorrow morning) 3) tom open docs PR with checklist (tomorrow) 4) cory get driver matrix (tomorrow EOD). We'll review Wed morning and deliver drafts to partner. Thanks all :rocket:
